owner: IeS Informatica e Servizi (commissioned via AASS), with TIM San Marino technical support
notes: San Marino RTV (state broadcaster, 10 Jul 2026) reports the Congress of State commissioned a preliminary feasibility study, via AASS (state public-services utility), from IeS Informatica e Servizi with technical support from TIM San Marino, presented to stakeholders to size a national data center. Framed as strategic for digital sovereignty serving the public administration, banking sector and private businesses, and potentially neighbouring Italian regions; TIM San Marino cites a Tier 4 security target. Division/location not yet determined; no capacity figures published.
